intent: Put a full-width line above an item row's media, content and actions.
typical_uses: A line of context above the row, such as a category and a date at either end

dont_use_when.situation: The title block at the top of a bounded panel

invariants.text: ItemHeader takes the full width of the Item's wrapping row, so it gets a line of its own, and spreads its children to both ends with a var(--space-2) gap. It sits above the rest of the row only when it comes first in the markup; its position follows the markup, not its name.

good.title: A category and a date above the row

bad.title: A header placed after the content
bad.why: ItemHeader goes where the markup puts it, so this one renders on its own line below the content; place it first.
